VinCheck.metaTitle: VIN check in Latvia | how a car history check works | PROVIN
VinCheck.metaDescription: VIN check before you buy a used car: what a VIN is, what a car history report shows, and why you also need a listing audit, not just a data dump.
VinCheck.h1: VIN check before you buy a car
VinCheck.lead: A VIN is the 17-character factory identifier. It lets us pull registries, service history and contradictions in the advert. PROVIN does not stop at a raw printout: we compare sources and say what that means for this car.
VinCheck.whatBody: A VIN check is a car history check by identification number: mileage, accidents, theft, registry records and, when available, official dealer service history. That is not the same as one database PDF. Sources only overlap in part, and listing photos often say more than a table row.
VinCheck.whyTitle: Why one car history report is not enough
VinCheck.whyBody: A standard report shows what was entered into a system. Sellers know that and often pick cars with a thin digital trail. So beside the VIN check, PROVIN reads the listing and the weak points of that model. If you have a listing link, add it to the order.
VinCheck.howTitle: How a check works at PROVIN
VinCheck.howBody: Enter the VIN or plate on the home page, choose MINI or AUDITS, and add the listing if you have it. MINI fits a car already used in Latvia. AUDITS is the deeper check for an import: international databases, dealer systems and auction archives when they exist. Results usually arrive in 24-72h, with a short call after the report.
VinCheck.homeTitle: VIN check and car history check
VinCheck.homeBody: If you need a VIN check or a car history check before you buy, start with the VIN and the listing link. Next we explain what the check includes and which package to pick.
VinCheck.relatedPostsTitle: From the blog: buying a used car

VinDecoder.metaTitle: Free VIN decoder: manufacturer, country and year | PROVIN
VinDecoder.metaDescription: Free VIN decoder: manufacturer, country of manufacture and possible model year from the VIN. History, mileage and listing analysis in the PROVIN audit.
VinDecoder.title: VIN decoder
VinDecoder.lead: Enter a Latvian plate or a 17-character VIN. For a plate we show make, model, year, engine and inspection date; for a VIN - manufacturer, country and, for many makes, model and year. Free, no sign-up.
VinDecoder.errChars: A VIN never contains I, O or Q. Please check the input.
VinDecoder.checkBad: Mismatch: possible typo or altered VIN
VinDecoder.yearHint: The 10th character repeats every 30 years; the correct year follows from the car and its documents.
VinDecoder.limitsTitle: What a VIN decoder does not show
VinDecoder.limitsBody: The VIN itself holds no mileage, accidents, inspection defects or number of owners. Those come only from history databases and registers and must be compared with the listing.
VinDecoder.modelHint: The model comes from the manufacturer code in the VIN. One code can cover several models on the same platform, so all of them are listed.
VinDecoder.ctaAudit: Order a PROVIN AUDIT for this VIN
VinDecoder.errPlate: Latvian plate: 2-3 letters and 1-4 digits, for example AB1234.
VinDecoder.plateNotFound: Plate {plate} was not found in the CSDD register. Check what you entered.
VinDecoder.plateError: The CSDD register is not responding right now. Try again shortly or enter the VIN.
VinDecoder.plateQuota: Today's limit of free plate checks has been reached. Enter the VIN or try tomorrow.
VinDecoder.rateLimited: Too many checks in a short time. Try again shortly.
VinDecoder.plateSourceLine: Source: CSDD vehicle register. Not an official extract.
VinDecoder.memoryTitle: Our archive on this car: {n} records
VinDecoder.memoryBody: Mileage and dates from our earlier checks. You will see them in the PROVIN audit.

HomeFreeTools.title: Three things you can do
HomeFreeTools.lead: Start with a free step. Order the full audit only if the car is worth it.
HomeFreeTools.vinBody: For a Latvian plate you instantly see make, model, year, engine and the roadworthiness test date. For foreign cars the VIN gives the manufacturer, country and, for many brands, the model and year.
HomeFreeTools.listingBody: We read the listing like an experienced buyer: price, description, photos and contradictions between them. We email you a comment, free of charge.
HomeFreeTools.askBody: Not sure which report fits? Wondering whether a car from the UK, USA or Japan can be checked? Write to us and we will answer.
